name: Hexasodium Hexametaphosphate
description: Hexasodium Hexametaphosphate , also known by its CAS 10124-56-8 , is a condensed phosphate salt used across food, industrial, and water treatment applications. It functions primarily as a sequestrant and dispersant. The chemical works by binding calcium, magnesium, and heavy metal ions to prevent scale formation, precipitation, and product degradation. This makes it essential for maintaining stability in complex formulations. In food processing, this compound controls mineral interference in dairy, seafood, and processed meat products. It is highly effective at improving texture retention and moisture binding during production cycles. Water treatment operations use the material to inhibit scale and corrosion in boiler systems, cooling towers, and municipal pipelines. It ensures the longevity of infrastructure by preventing mineral buildup. In mining and mineral processing, it acts as a dispersant in ore slurries, improving separation efficiency and reducing reagent consumption. This helps optimize the extraction process for various minerals. Textile and paper manufacturing rely on this phosphate to sequester hardness ions in process water. This prevents interference with dyes, bleaches, and sizing agents, ensuring consistent product quality. The product is supplied as a white powder or granule. Food-grade material is available meeting FCC specifications, while technical-grade product is offered for various industrial applications. Purity levels and P₂O₅ content are the primary quality parameters buyers should confirm against their process requirements.
